about: Aggregates and per-video numbers for labs.sammii.dev/charts/videos/. No captions, on-screen text, ids, topics or exact dates.

definitions.median: midpoint of the two middle values for an even count
definitions.percentages: medianEr is a percentage to one decimal place; per-video er is a fraction to four
